title: Deterministic CFO-office finance suite (GST, NPV, loan annuity, IFRS 16, budget variance)
description: Seeded finance cases graded by code oracles, not by a judge model, drawn from the finance family: GST with rate boundaries and inclusive extraction, NPV of cash-flow streams, loan annuity schedules, IFRS 16 initial measurement, budget variance classification. Every case carries abstention probes and metamorphic twins (reorder, unit rescale, inclusive-price restatement). Rule parameters and their provenance live in minder_domain_evals/rulebook.py. Seeds >= 1000 are the holdout split. The committed fixture is a small dev sample; any (seed, n) regenerates byte-identically via --families finance.

tasks.title: Finance oracles pass themselves, every mutant fails, hand-worked anchors hold (tests/test_domain_evals.py)
Reference answers replay through the grader at 100% on the committed dev sample
Model under test through the minder proxy: python -m minder_domain_evals run --families finance / score; compare reports with minder-op benchmark compare
